lines.text: How's the elbow been since last time?
If I'm honest it's about the same since last time and still sore lifting the kettle.
Gripping the dynamometer, you're at 22 kilos on the right against 38 on the left.
The cups seemed to settle it last time, so I'll do those again.
The cups left a bruise for about a week, but I might be muddling it up with something else.
Fair enough, I'll go a bit lighter today. When you carry anything, palm up rather than palm down, it takes the strain off the tendon.
Right, that's you sorted. Same time next week.
Good morning, Mr Oyelaran, thank you for waiting. Do take a seat.
Morning. It's my right knee, it's been swelling up after five a side.
